title: ComponentMeta
description: Schema for *.meta.json files that describe each web component in the design system. Extends the Custom Elements Manifest with usage intent, token references, accessibility contracts, and Figma mappings.

allOf.$comment: tokensUsed is DERIVED from anatomy (#188). A component that declares an anatomy must NOT author it — the anatomy tree is the single source, and a hand-written copy is the drift this whole contract exists to end. build:meta injects the derived list into design-system.json, so consumers see no difference. Components without an anatomy still author it, until their promotion batch lands.

metaVersion.description: Semver version of this meta file. Distinct from the merged design-system.json $schemaVersion.

status.description: Production-readiness. 'stable' = productionized, API frozen; 'beta' = usable but API may change; 'experimental' = early/unstable. Surfaced in design-system.json and component doc front-matter.

name.description: Component tag name (e.g. rr-badge). Used as both the custom element tag and the canonical identifier.

summary.description: One-line description of the component, suitable for search results and MCP tool responses.

tokensUsed.description: CSS custom properties this component references. Must be semantic tokens — never primitives (the component tier was removed in #114). The prefix list must cover every semantic scale: `letter-spacing` was missing until #187, so rr-dialog, rr-tag and rr-table-cell could not declare the tracking tokens their styles used.

anatomy.description: Structured part tree with per-part token bindings (#156 stage 2). Transcribed from the component's actual styles — never inferred. Opt-in per component; metas without it are exempt from the anatomy gate.

rules.description: Usage rules and constraints from ai/rules.md that apply to this component.

ariaPattern.description: Link to the WAI-ARIA Authoring Practices pattern this component implements.

ariaLive.description: Live region politeness. Omit if the component is not a live region.

wcag.description: WCAG 2.2 success criteria this component must satisfy (e.g. '1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum)').

rules.description: Component-specific accessibility rules beyond WCAG (e.g. 'aria-errormessage must mirror aria-describedby').

componentKey.description: Figma component key for Code Connect mapping.

nodeId.description: Figma node ID for Code Connect mapping.

codeConnectFile.description: Path to the .figma.ts Code Connect file, relative to the component directory.

ignoredOptions.description: Figma variant options that are design-reference only and deliberately emit no code (e.g. State: default/hover/active/focus — CSS-only states). Keyed by Figma property name. The parity differ treats these as covered; anything else unbound is drift.

bindings.description: Dual code↔design binding for one prop (#152). Machine-checkable source for the Code Connect mapping and the Figma parity differ; validate fails when it disagrees with the component's *.figma.ts.

prop.description: The code-side property name. Must equal the prop this binding is attached to.

kind.description: Figma component-property kind this prop binds to.

property.description: The Figma property name, e.g. "Variant" or "State".

valueMap.description: Figma option → code value. A boolean value means the option derives a boolean prop (e.g. State=disabled → disabled: true). Omit for 1:1 TEXT/BOOLEAN bindings.

anyOf.description: The only permitted non-token values. Per #114 `transparent` is a CSS keyword, not a colour literal — it needs no token. Contrast derivation ignores both.

anatomyTokens.description: Semantic token bindings for one part. Colour keys admit only --color-* (which structurally excludes primitives and the deleted component tier, #114). v2 adds radius/shadow/motion/focus (#178 items 1-2), which took 29 tokens that were declared in tokensUsed but attached to no part down to zero.

anyOf.description: The spacing tokens this part binds, in authored order (gap, then padding block/inline). Deduped — a token used twice is listed once.

shadow.description: Genuine elevation. NOT the focus ring — a focus indicator drawn with box-shadow binds `focus`, so that the fact survives the mechanism.

anyOf.description: A transition binds a duration AND an easing, so the array form is the common case — same shape as spacing.

focus.description: The part's focus indicator, bound BY ROLE rather than by the CSS that draws it. The library draws focus rings three ways — `outline` (checkbox, dialog, link, radio, tab, toast, toggle), `box-shadow` (button, input, menu-item, select, textarea) and `border-color` (input, select, textarea) — for no design reason. Keying on the mechanism would need three keys and still could not answer 'does this component's focus indicator meet SC 1.4.11 (3:1)', which is the fact the contract exists to state. This is the one deliberate abstraction over the CSS in anatomy; every other key transcribes literally.

anatomyCondition.description: One condition term: "variant=success" (prop=value), "disabled" (boolean prop / attribute), ":hover" (CSS pseudo-class), or any of those negated with a leading "!". validate resolves the prop=value and bare-prop forms against props[] — negation does not exempt a term from that check; pseudo-classes are not checked. Negation exists because real selectors guard on absence: checkbox's hover rule is `:host(:not([disabled]):not([checked]):not([indeterminate])) .box-wrap:hover .box`, which without it is inexpressible and leaves --color-border-hover attached to no part.

anatomyState.description: A variant/state overlay on a part's resting bindings. Only the keys that actually change are listed.

anyOf.description: Compound condition — every term must hold (AND). Transcribed from a selector that stacks them, e.g. `:host([variant='secondary']) button:hover` → ["variant=secondary", ":hover"]. Each term is validated separately by the same parser, so a typo in any one of them fails the build. A single-term array is pointless — use the string form.

when.description: The condition this overlay fires on, transcribed from the selector. One term or several ANDed. See $defs/anatomyCondition for the term grammar.

name.description: Part identifier, unique among its siblings. "root" conventionally names the :host.

element.description: The element or selector this part transcribes, e.g. ":host", "button", ".label".

cssPart.description: The exported CSS part name, when this part is addressable via ::part(). Must match a cssParts[] entry.

accepts.description: Element tags this slot accepts (e.g. rr-menu-item, svg). Omit when the slot is genuinely unconstrained — only encode constraints the component actually assumes. '*' is an explicit anything; '#text' means plain text content.
